title: Two-Tone
tagline: Ska stripped to a sharper, more anxious post-punk edge.
summary: Two-tone took ska’s rhythmic punch and placed it alongside punk energy, a stripped production style and social commentary. Its music often feels brisk and tense rather than pure celebration, balancing vintage rhythm with a contemporary urban point of view. The sound became a bridge between Jamaican music traditions and British youth culture.

pillars.name: The Specials
pillars.why: The Specials made two-tone feel immediate and politically sharp without sacrificing melodic clarity.

pillars.name: Madness
pillars.why: Madness brought more melodic ease to the sound while keeping its rhythmic tension intact.

pillars.name: The Selecter
pillars.why: The Selecter placed the social and musical language of ska into a more directly post-punk context.
